label: Sky Backdrop
description: The sky world's full-bleed ground: cumulus clouds drifting slowly across a sky in the brand color (the palette's primary; a deeper band at the top, lighter toward the horizon). Clouds are drawn from the world seed -- shaded puffs, turbulence edges, a soft halo -- or come from cloud sprites in the brand kit; they keep the upper corners and the low band, never the centre where the type lives, and drift on film time so a cut never resets them. Cast by the build as the film's one backdrop; scenes do not choose it.

seed.label: World seed (cloud shapes, sizes and slots)

colors.label: World palette; the first color is the sky

tone.label: Sky color override (default: the palette's first color)

density.label: How much sky the clouds take, 0-1 (default 0.35: two big clouds in the upper corners and one low)

drift.label: Drift in px per second, rightward (default 9; 0 holds the clouds still)

clouds.label: Cloud sprites: transparent PNG URLs from the brand kit, used instead of the drawn clouds

time_offset.label: Film seconds at which this scene starts (set by the build for continuity)
